name: mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase kinase 1

function.text: MAP3K1 encodes mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase kinase 1. Annotated molecular activities include protein kinase activity and protein serine kinase activity. It participates in MAPK cascade and protein phosphorylation.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to 46,XY sex reversal 6 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Invasive breast carcinoma of no special type. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from G2P. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

function.text: MAP3K1 encodes mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase kinase 1. It participates in MAPK cascade and protein phosphorylation. Functional annotations also associate the protein with protein kinase activity and protein serine kinase activity.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with 46,XY sex reversal 6 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MAP3K1 have been reported in invasive breast carcinoma of no special type, plasma cell myeloma, and colon adenocarcinoma.
